description: This source file implements a sample application demonstrating the use of the GL_OVR_multiview2 extension in OpenGL. It sets up layered rendering for stereo views, manages shaders, framebuffers, and geometry, and renders multiple cubes with multiview support.

classes.name: MultiviewSample
classes.description: A class derived from SampleApplication that manages the setup, rendering, and cleanup of a multiview OpenGL sample demonstrating layered stereo rendering.

methods.name: FillTranslationMatrix
methods.description: Fills a 4x4 translation matrix with specified offsets.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL resources, shaders, textures, framebuffers, and geometry for the multiview sample.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up OpenGL resources allocated by the application.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs rendering: renders layered stereo views to a framebuffer, then combines and displays the result.
